CREATE PROCEDURE USR_USP_DATAFORMTEMPLATE_ADD_STEPADDFORM2 ( @ID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER = NULL OUTPUT ,@INTERACTIONID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER ,@CHANGEAGENTID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER = NULL ,@EVENTID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER = NULL ) AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON SET @ID = ISNULL(@ID,NEWID()) IF @CHANGEAGENTID IS NULL EXEC USP_CHANGEAGENT_GETORCREATECHANGEAGENT @CHANGEAGENTID OUTPUT DECLARE @NOW DATETIME = GETDATE()
BEGIN TRY --Extensions always fire *after* their parent form. --So we can safely assume that the new interaction exists. --note that the "@INTERACTIONID" is the *context* of this extension. --you can control the name of the context id in the "<Context" tag below. IF @EVENTID IS NOT NULL BEGIN --This will FAIL with a constraint violation: --CK_INTERACTION_EVENTIDNOTPRESENTWHENSTEP UPDATE INTERACTION SET EVENTID = @EVENTID ,DATECHANGED = @NOW ,CHANGEDBYID = @CHANGEAGENTID WHERE ID = @INTERACTIONID END END TRY BEGIN CATCH EXEC USP_RAISE_ERROR RETURN 1 END CATCH RETURN 0 END
